note: Sizes are measured unified-memory footprints on DGX Spark, not docker stats (UMA under-reports). Dated so this does not become a museum.

os.name: OS + desktop
os.why: Kernel, desktop, agents. Live DS4F leftover after weights+KV was ~17 GB — 8 GB was a lie.
os.label: 16 GB each
os.source: Live node1: 105.9 used − 79.2 weights − 9.9 KV ≈ 16.8 GB leftover.

modules.name: DS4F-0731
modules.why: 79.2 GB of weights per rank. TP2 fills Spark 1 and 2. One Spark cannot hold both ranks.
modules.label: 79.2 GB / rank
modules.source: vLLM boot split on a live TP=2 serve.

modules.name: KV cache
modules.why: Per rank at util 0.75 / 524k ctx. Needs DS4F. 1M ctx at 0.85 is how boxes go tight.
modules.label: 9.9 GB / rank

modules.name: Vision 4B
modules.why: TP1 sidecar. On two Sparks it sits on Spark 2 beside the cluster. Do not put 9B vision TP2 under DS4F.
modules.label: 5.4 GB · TP1
modules.source: Measured RSS beside DS4F on the worker Spark.

modules.name: Helper 35B
modules.why: llama.cpp BALANCED profile. On 3 Sparks it takes the spare. On 2 it displaces the cluster.
modules.label: 39.5 GB · TP1

modules.name: H3 video
modules.why: Asymmetric: 89.4 GB on Spark 1, 41.4 on Spark 2. Cannot share a tank with DS4F. That pairing hard-rebooted a box.
modules.label: 89.4 + 41.4 · TP2
modules.source: Measured during the H3 + resident OOM incident.

modules.name: Qwen 27B
modules.why: TP1 deep lane. 36 GB KV pool measured. TP2 deadlocked — not a shipped layout.
modules.label: 36 GB · TP1
modules.source: Helper-mode deep lane, not co-resident with DS4F.

modules.name: Gemma 31B
modules.why: Ollama line, TP1. Fits a spare Spark. Unload it before a cluster start.
modules.label: 19 GB · TP1
modules.source: Ollama resident size on a single Spark.
